english.note: Use 比喻 as the all-purpose term, especially for a religious or moral story such as one told by Jesus.

exampleSentences.english: Jesus told this parable to teach people to forgive others.
exampleSentences.traditional: 耶穌講過呢個比喻，教人要寬恕別人。
